summary: EFCAR, LLC, as depositor and registrant for four Exeter Automobile Receivables Trusts (2022-2 through 2022-5), filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Capital Contribution Agreement dated September 15, 2026, with Exeter Finance LLC and acknowledged by Citibank, N.A. as indenture trustee. The pact permits EFCAR, as equity holder, to make limited capital contributions to those trusts. No purchase price, stake, premium, or board recommendation applies. This is a routine securitization structural amendment, not a special situation; watch for potential credit-support top-ups if collateral performance deteriorates.
